name: Belshazzar
overview: Belshazzar, identified as king of Babylon, is depicted in Scripture as hosting a grand feast where he and his court drank from golden vessels taken from the temple in Jerusalem, using them to praise false gods of various materials. During this revelry, a mysterious hand appeared, writing on the palace wall, which deeply troubled Belshazzar and caused him great fear. These events highlight his irreverence toward the true God and set the stage for divine judgment.
